stage: Settlement release milestone 2: separate role-specific count budgets and audit resident-size evidence
exposure: Both saved Han AD2 and Roman AD150 pools, all old model positions and source workbooks are exposed development data. Vidarbha prospective parameter-transfer test now spent and failed its declared capture guard. This is development, not a new blind test. No geography removed because it scores poorly.
inputs: Exact original output/settlement_locations_20261110/{han,rome}_inputs.npz and original positions/results; verify hashes. Keep population/occupation,eligibility,physics and placement modules unchanged. Read original primary source workbooks/shapefiles for source-role,size-support and same-cell multiplicity audit,not for new coordinates or anchors. No raw third-party rows published.
units: Two separate responses: Han county/commandery-seat records versus Roman urban-catalogue records. Primary target retains every allowed source record even when several snap to one model cell; secondary distinct-cell target documents resolution. Neither response is all villages. Han CountyPOP is county population,not town residents. Roman Areas are archaeological extent/proxy,not directly observed people;old rank-median fills and exact20/30ha default-value candidates must be counted separately;nondefault numeric values are not automatically certified measured or contemporaneous.
blocks_and_folds: Primary approximately100km square blocks (round100/cell);secondary approximately300km (round300/cell),record actual km. Include partial edge blocks with actual allowed-land exposure. Four geographic folds by each block centre's quadrant about model-grid midpoint,independent of observed counts. All positive-area blocks including zeros retained. Leave one quadrant out,fit coefficients using the other three. Report every fold with source records,land exposure,model population and zero-prediction failures. No removing hard regions or every-region-improves veto.
models: Frozen observed production placements as a descriptive count-map reference,not an untouched estimator. Fit separate-pool Poisson mean mu=k*A*(P/A)^beta for beta in[0,0.5,0.7,1,1.5],A allowedland km2,P unchanged model residents. k=sum training count/sum training exposure-weighted density^beta,only on training folds. Area-only beta0 and prior seat exponent beta0.7 retained as explicit comparators. Shared-scale role-pooling control uses the other three geographic quadrants in both pools;role-specific scales remain distinct. No free population multiplier,no observed count supplied to placement,no new point realization.
metrics: Poisson deviance per exposed land area and per observed source record,absolute total-count relative error,share of source count mass to relocate after total normalization,and nonempty count-rank as a secondary descriptor. Literal zero predicted intensity with positive observation is an explicit infinite-loss/support failure,not silently floored or dropped. All per-fold and equal-pool aggregates retained. Betas ranked on mean equal-pool per-source-record deviance across all four held quadrants at the primary grid;this is exposed-development model selection,not independent validation. Keep role-specific results and secondary resolution in full;no new production adoption from selection alone.
resident_size_support: Directly audit Cities/Areas sheets and source IDs/date fields without old median filling. Preserve duplicate/missing/nonnumeric/nonpositive areas,20/30ha default-value candidates,AD150 temporal selection and denominator changes. Directly audit Han point TYPE/year/CountyPOP units and nonnumeric/zero values. Literature reference Hanson & Ortman2017 doi10.1017/S1047759400074134 supports area-population scaling from housing evidence,but this workbook and county counts alone do not supply exact urban resident labels. Do not manufacture resident observations from area,countyPOP or icon size.
review_and_consumer: Independent source support and direct block/fold exposure/prediction/deviance reconstruction;fresh numerical replay;old artifacts and active r44/fantasy ledgers unchanged. Publish aggregate count-fit curves/size-support plus limitations in normal atlas evidence,show generated figures,commit/push only friendly branch and continue. Use results to choose the next role-specific count/resident allocation implementation;all actor/mobile/nonstate coverage and shared population/food/staff/control ledger remain mandatory. First-map release milestones3/4 stay pending until numerical changes qualified and rebuilt.
